evals.prompt: We are redesigning a dashboard while another dev keeps adding features. How should we use git?
assertions: Addresses redesign and parallel feature work
Mentions worktrees or side-by-side comparison when useful

evals.prompt: I want Codex to help in this repo but I do not want it overwriting files my teammate is editing.
assertions: Coordinates shared-file ownership without pretending notes enforce locks
Follows the repository review policy without inventing extra approval gates

evals.prompt: I am solo but want clean commits and deployable main for a client prototype.
I'm building a solo weekend prototype. Set up a git workflow.
assertions: Does not impose multi-agent review machinery

evals.prompt: The user authorized a Fumadocs upgrade. Our manifest and lockfile must agree; another contributor has unrelated edits.
assertions: Updates the lockfile through the package manager
Does not invent a blanket dependency or local-edit approval ban
